object:hexagonal / fire.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a warm ochre rod with dark brown lower shadow and angled upper tip lying diagonally from lower left to upper right. The teal pattern is the floor, not wand decoration.
object:hexagonal / fire.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki documents the wand of fire as a zap-usable wand. The hexagonal descriptor is a possible unidentified appearance; wand appearances shuffle, so the shown rod cannot reveal its effect.
object:hexagonal / fire.modelBrief: Build a slim six-sided wand with muted warm ochre faces. Keep its thin 32-pixel silhouette and do not add a visual effect that would imply the source-associated wand identity.
